Metric rewards few corners with long balanced legs, NOT fine arcs (chords shrink min(L) -> slower). Proxy-guided moves (vertex remove/relocate, coarse chamfer, collinear split to isolate slow zones) with e/m(v)~150/v-1.6 fit should recover most of it.
